windows-amd64.rationale: P1-04/AR-P-01 repair (#691 T10): the pure INIT/READY, frame, snapshot-exchange, reader/Publisher bridge and worker-multiplexer codecs moved from accidental linux build tags to portable files per ADR-0129 decision 2, so the portable deterministic lane compiles and executes their behavior tests on Windows and macOS. Their production consumers remain the selected Linux-only composition: the installed text worker entrypoint reaches RunWorker only through the Linux inherited-descriptor mechanism (the unsupported-platform adapter refuses before it), and InitializeWorker/ServeWorkerConnections/AwaitRetainedWorkerConnection/NewSnapshot/Respond plus the Stream qualification Endpoint bridge are reached only by Linux execution/runtime and Endpoint owners. Windows command adapters refuse before runtime acquisition, so these symbols are production-dead on windows-amd64 only; the native-tag Windows test analysis reaches them through the now-portable behavior tests. The genuine Linux mechanisms (snapshot_file_linux.go, worker_process_linux.go) keep their linux tags and explicit !linux typed refusals. Linux production reachability is unchanged and required.
windows-amd64.owner: Product Owner and Codex; Text Application and Stream qualification protocol owners (#691 T10, P1-04/AR-P-01)
